high_level_description: This image depicts the front facade of Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris, France. The architectural style is clearly Gothic, characterized by its pointed arches, intricate stonework, and large rose windows. Architecture: The facade features two large towers on either side, which are part of the cathedral's overall structure. The central section of the facade includes a prominent rose window, a circular stained-glass window with a radiating pattern typical of Gothic architecture. Below the rose window, there are several arched openings, some of which appear to be windows or decorative elements.
